extDescription.message: Turns the page you are viewing into a PDF identical to the screen: native browser rendering, no reload, selectable text, links and bookmarks.

actionTitle.message: Web2PDF Exact — convert this page to PDF

cmdFull.message: Convert the whole page to PDF (default settings)

cmdVisible.message: Convert the visible area to PDF

cmdElement.message: Pick an element to convert to PDF

cmdRegion.message: Draw an area to convert to PDF

credit.message: Designed with the help of Wheeloh resources

pdfProducer.message: Web2PDF Exact — Designed with the help of Wheeloh resources

phasePick.message: Waiting for your selection in the page…

phasePaused.message: Paused: come back to the tab to continue…

restrictedReader.message: Reader view is an internal page: extensions cannot capture it pixel for pixel. Use the “Vector” engine or leave reader view.

restrictedInternal.message: This internal browser page is protected: no extension can access it.

restrictedHost.message: The browser does not allow extensions to access $1.

noticeReader.message: Reader view: only the “Vector” engine can convert this view.

noticeInternal.message: Internal browser page: extensions have no access to it.

errBusy.message: A capture is already running in this tab.

errInject.message: Cannot access this page ($1). Internal browser pages and some protected sites are off-limits to extensions.

errReloaded.message: The page was reloaded or closed during the capture.

errNoPrint.message: This browser does not offer PDF printing to extensions.

errPrepare.message: The page could not be prepared.

errNotSaved.message: The PDF could not be saved.

errCaptureRefused.message: The browser refused to capture this page.

errEmpty.message: Nothing to capture: the area is empty or outside the page.

warnTruncatedPage.message: Page cut at $1 px high (“Maximum height” setting).

warnTruncatedContent.message: Content cut at $1 px high (“Maximum height” setting).

warnSheets.message: $1 style sheet(s) from another domain could not be adapted to the screen.

pickHint.message: Click the element to convert  ·  ↑ parent  ↓ child  ·  Enter confirm  ·  Esc cancel

regionHint.message: Draw the area to convert (the mouse wheel scrolls)  ·  Esc cancel

cleanupHint.message: Click the elements to remove  ·  Ctrl+Z restore  ·  Enter capture  ·  Esc cancel

cleanupHintCount.message: $1 element(s) removed  ·  Ctrl+Z restore  ·  Enter capture  ·  Esc cancel

engineHintExact.message: The browser’s rendering is captured as is: identical to the screen, with selectable text, links and bookmarks.

engineHintVector.message: Uses the print engine: vector text and a light file, but the layout may differ from the screen.

optHeaderFooter.message: Header and footer (title, address, date, page no.)

optSaveAs.message: Choose where to save the file

hintScroll.message: The page scrolls by itself during the capture: let it work. Esc to stop.

hintPrint.message: Choose where to save the file in the save dialog.

hintPaused.message: The capture will resume as soon as the tab is shown again.

hintPick.message: Make your selection directly in the page.

hintBuild.message: The page is already back to normal; the PDF is being written.

optIntro.message: Every setting is saved as soon as it changes and becomes the default for the popup, the right-click menu and the keyboard shortcuts.

engExactDesc.message: The browser draws the page with its own engine and that image goes into the PDF: CSS, fonts, canvas, videos and iframes come out exactly as on screen. An invisible text layer keeps the text selectable and searchable; links and bookmarks stay active.

engVectorDesc.message: Uses the browser’s “Save to PDF” after forcing screen styles. Vector text and a very light file, but some sites change their layout when printed. A dialog asks where to save.

methodHelp.message: Scrolling triggers deferred images, reveal animations and virtual lists. Direct rendering is instant and avoids seams on parallax effects.

settleHelp.message: The capture moves on as soon as the page is stable; raise it for slow or heavily animated sites.

startDelayHelp.message: Time to open a menu or hover an element you want frozen in the PDF.

chkPreload.message: Preload the whole page before capturing (deferred images, content loaded on scroll)

chkFreeze.message: Finish transitions and animations instantly (no half-revealed elements)

chkContainer.message: Unroll the scrolling panel of web apps (chats, documents, dashboards)

chkOverflow.message: Include horizontal overflow (pages wider than the screen)

chkCleanup.message: Always offer to remove elements before capturing

ratioHelp.message: “Your screen’s” reproduces exactly what you see (×2 on a Retina display).

compHelp.message: Automatic: lossless for text and flat colours, JPEG for photos.

jpegHelp.message: From 90 up, colours are not subsampled.

chkSmartBreaks.message: Smart page breaks: never cut a line of text or an image between two pages

chkLimitSize.message: Single page: stay under 200 inches (Acrobat compatibility; the image keeps its full resolution)

chkHeaderFooter.message: Header (title, address) and footer (date, page number)

chkTextLayer.message: Selectable, copyable and searchable text (invisible layer aligned with the image)

chkLinks.message: Clickable links, including the page’s internal anchors

chkBookmarks.message: Bookmarks generated from the page’s headings

filenameHelp.message: Variables: {title} {domain} {host} {path} {date} {time} {datetime}. Use “/” to file PDFs into subfolders of the download folder, for example Web2PDF/{domain}/{date} {title}.

afterDownloadOpen.message: Download and open in a tab

chkSaveAs.message: Ask where to save each file

chkNotify.message: Notification when done (click it to open the PDF)

chkEmulateScreen.message: Print with screen styles (neutralises the page’s @media print rules)

chkFitWidth.message: Lay out at screen width, then shrink to fit the paper

vectorNote.message: Known limits of printing: sections one screen tall (100vh) take the paper’s height, and style sheets from other domains cannot be adapted. The exact engine has none of these limits.

ctxDirect.message: Direct: “Convert page to PDF” in one click

ctxFull.message: Full submenu (page, visible area, element, area, vector)

ctxHelp.message: Every mode is also available by right-clicking the extension’s toolbar icon.

shortcutsText.message: Alt + Shift + P opens the popup. Direct shortcuts also exist (whole page, visible area, element, drawn area): assign them in about:addons → gear icon → Manage Extension Shortcuts.

escText.message: During a capture, <kbd>Esc</kbd> stops it and puts the page back exactly as it was.
